        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pt.level + 1,
        pt.qty_multiplier * pr.qty

    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
)

    current_id,
    level,
    qty_multiplier
FROM packaging_tree
ORDER BY root_id, level
